scope: Independent original-execution reference of the cold-boot texture/handle lifecycle from power-on through storage readiness, both logos, logo resource retirement and title construction, stopping at the RETURN of 0x12c350 with selector 1 (paused at its return address, before the first 0x1296f8 title update). Unchanged retail SCUS_971.29 under the Play research VM, neutral pad. Research evidence only; not physical PS2 proof; never product input.

play.tree_cleanliness: not verified (git on the Play checkout was not run from the isolated worktree)

oracle.build_dir: build/title-oracle (fresh; configured and built from scratch in the worktree)
oracle.mode: --title (implies the RNG --rng-products observations); --title --minimal for the control run. Default Startup mode re-verified byte-identical to local/research/startup-original-v1/runs/fill00-a (events, GS ledger, disc opens, VRAM, final state, EE RAM) with this source.

inputs.play_config: fresh default configuration (and memory card directory) created by Play in <evidence>/cwd/<run>/local/play-boot-config

fixed_settings.pad: RecordedPad with no input rows (neutral sticks, no buttons)
fixed_settings.gs: null renderer (no rasterisation) + ledger: host-to-local writes performed by Play; primitives, local-to-local and CLUT loads classified, never executed
fixed_settings.vram_initial_fill: 0x00 (fill00-a/b, control) and 0xff (fillff-a/b), applied before the first guest instruction
fixed_settings.stop: return address of 0x12c350 when its selector (obj+0x24) is 1; the VM stays paused there (EE PC 0x11528c)

commands: OKAGE_PLAY_VM_LOCK=<main>/local/research/.play-vm.lock tools/title_capture.sh <evidence>/bin/okage-startup-oracle "<main>/local/disc/Okage - Shadow King (USA).cue" <main>/local/extracted/SCUS_971.29 <evidence>   # as executed: the same five oracle invocations issued one at a time under the lock (cd <evidence>/cwd/<run> && <oracle> DISC ELF <evidence>/runs/<run> 00|ff --deadline-seconds 5400 --title [--minimal] > <evidence>/runs/<run>.log 2>&1)
limitations: Play research backend, Debug build; not a physical PS2 proof. Play tree cleanliness not verified.

The null renderer rasterises nothing: draw/local-to-local "writes" are ledger classifications (conservative rectangles), not observed memory contents. The required-unknown set is therefore a conservative superset of real coverage (vertex bounding boxes clipped to SCISSOR, FBMSK/ZMSK/TEST-NEVER honoured).
Written-lane masks are paired-fill derived and cross-checked against the ledger upload footprint (equal).

Play PSMCT24 host-to-local transfers read 3-byte pixels per chunk; every PSMCT24 chunk here was a multiple of 3 bytes (ledger ct24_chunks_not_multiple_of_3 = 0), so no chunk-boundary artefact applies.
ee_event fields in gs-ledger.jsonl are an approximate host-thread cross-reference and are excluded from determinism; every other ledger field is identical across the four runs.
Hooks perturb timing (stop at 843 vblanks hooked, 822 in the minimal control); state, VRAM and selectors agree.
ee-ram snapshots are the first 32 MiB of EE RAM only.
